claim: Cancer and cardiovascular disease (CVD) are the two leading causes of non-communicable disease mortality globally.

claim: The omega-3 index is defined as the percentage of eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) in total fatty acids in red blood cells.
